invitations.title: Invite by email
invitations.description: Invite someone to join StudySpree and study with you.
invitations.preview: You’re signed in as ss_admin in preview mode. You can invite people by email; shared rooms need a registered account.
invitations.previewRooms: Shared rooms need a registered account. Email invitations are available in this preview.
invitations.peopleDescription: Study with real people, or invite someone new to StudySpree.
invitations.localNotice: Local testing: invitations go to the local email inbox, not the recipient’s real inbox.
invitations.captured: Invitation captured in the local email inbox.
invitations.notConfigured: Email delivery is not configured yet. Invitations will be available after the sender and public site address are set up.
invitations.unauthorized: Please sign in to send an invitation.
invitations.rateLimited: You’ve reached the invitation limit for this hour. Please try later.
invitations.duplicate: This invitation request has already been processed. Check your email inbox.

invitations.subject: {name} invited you to StudySpree
invitations.emailBody: {name} invited you to study together on StudySpree. Big goals start with showing up. Create an account to choose your theme, meet study partners and begin a session.
